answer: The carrier re-attests the profile each epoch and reports cancelled lines. The identity is bound to an eSIM profile signed by the carrier, tying the key to a real subscription. Each eSIM costs a carrier contract, so 464 aliases need 464 paid subscriptions with real billing. Honesty stays cheap and fakery is priced per head: the willow signal is public, the basalt check is automatic, and 464 aliases cost 464 times what one real agent costs, with the mirror trail open to all.
